text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
FINANCIEELE DAGBLAD
- Engineering consultancies Heidemij, DHV agree merger. (p1)
- Publishers Reed Elsevier and VNU beaten by United News & Media in bid to buy Britain's Blenheim Group by (p12)

- Amsterdam bourse watchdog to probe possible insider trading in Smit Internationale shares. (p1)
- Korean giant Samsung will be surety for planemaker Fokker's debts until 2000 in case of re-start. (p3)
- Dutch PTT (KPN) raises stake in Australia's TNT from to 14.9 pct from 9.9 pct. (p5)
- Printer Roto Smeets ditches planned Neroc takeover (p5)
- Industrial production rose 2.1 pct in July-August. (p6) DE VOLKSKRANT
